verdict.rationale: Portkey's REST API is served under a versioned base URL (`https://api.portkey.ai/v1`), which suggests some API versioning, but nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, version lifecycle, or migration guarantees. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, published machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration.
